literal: Embraced hands as they relaxed, turned pale the beautiful-braceleted innocent woman's forehead.
translation: The moment we relaxed our tight embrace, even slightly, paleness spread over the forehead of my simple beloved who wears beautiful bracelets.
modern: தழுவியிருந்த கைகளைச் சற்றே தளர்த்திய உடனே, அழகிய வளையல்களை அணிந்த இப்பேதை பெண்ணின் நெற்றி பசலை நிறமடைந்தது.
explanation: This couplet depicts the extreme sensitivity of the heroine to even a momentary separation. The hero observes that when they slightly loosened their embrace, her forehead immediately turned pale with grief. The word 'paim-toṭi' refers to her beautiful bracelets, and 'pēthai' highlights her innocent, tender nature. Her instant physical reaction of turning pale shows how deeply she feels even the slightest distance from her lover.
